instant.title: Alex, can we hand this off?

posts.alt: Quirq agent test report with 46 of 48 checks passing and two timeout failures awaiting a fix decision
posts.caption: 46 of 48 agent checks are green. The remaining two fail when the tool response takes more than 8 seconds. @alex.morgan, should we retry once or show the fallback immediately? Logs and the failing cases are in this review.

comments.text: Both failures use the same slow-tool fixture. One bounded retry should recover them.
I can design a clear retry state. We should still offer a way to cancel.

instant.title: Which fix should we test first?

posts.caption: Release candidate 0.8 is ready. Keyboard navigation, mobile layouts and the invite flow have passed QA. The only open item is the empty-state copy. @alex.morgan, ship this version or hold for that change?

comments.text: Smoke tests are green on desktop and mobile. No release blockers from QA.
The copy update is tiny. I can land it before we tag the release.

posts.caption: Sharing the first pass of our research handoff. The agent gathers the sources, then a person approves the summary. @alex.morgan, is it obvious where your review starts? A quick comment on the checkpoint would help.

comments.text: In the last session, people wanted the review action right beside the sources. This feels closer.
